items.headline: FAA orders crack inspections for hundreds of Boeing 737 Max jets
items.summary: The FAA's final rule applies to 471 US-registered 737-8, 737-9 and 737-8200 aircraft and takes effect on 10 September. It requires inspections addressing a cracking concern and any necessary corrective action.

items.headline: easyJet accepts a £5.7 billion takeover offer from Apollo
items.summary: easyJet accepted Apollo Global Management's offer, but completion still depends on shareholder approval and regulatory clearance. The ownership structure must also comply with British and European airline-control rules.

items.headline: Brazilian police formally accuse 16 people over the 2024 Voepass crash
items.summary: Brazil's federal police formally accused 16 current and former Voepass employees following its investigation of the fatal ATR 72 crash. Prosecutors will decide whether to bring charges.

items.headline: Air India Phuket-Delhi flight encounters severe turbulence
items.summary: NDTV reported that Flight AI2379 encountered severe turbulence en route from Phuket to Delhi, with passengers injured. The occurrence was subsequently treated as a serious incident under investigation.
